script_text: Fire sign Aries, this week Mars your ruling planet ignites your 7th House with a fiery conjunction, and things are about to get intense. Early week Monday through Wednesday, Venus trines your 1st House, putting magnetic charm on your side, making Monday your strongest day for career advances and bold pitches. But watch out Tuesday as Mercury squares your 3rd House, sparking miscommunications and arguments with colleagues. Wednesday evening marks the turning point as the Sun enters a harmonious sextile with Jupiter in your 5th House, flooding your romantic sector with opportunity. Thursday through Sunday brings a surge of creative energy and passion into love, so singles you will meet someone electric this weekend. However, Saturday demands caution as Mars clashes with Pluto in your 10th House, threatening power struggles around money or career authority. Wednesday is your power day because the Jupiter sextile supercharges luck and confidence. Saturday is your worst day as the Mars Pluto square brings controlling drama and financial tension. Keep fire sign energy focused on creation not destruction this week, Aries. Follow for daily updates.
